cases.scenario: The task depends on an upstream interface, but its artifact and exact contract are missing from the sealed brief.
expected: Return NEEDS_CONTEXT before editing.
Name the missing upstream artifact or contract.
Do not invent an interface or product decision.

cases.scenario: A feature task adds one observable API behavior while all existing callers and unrelated responses are frozen unchanged.
expected: Map the new acceptance IDs to exact implementation and evidence.
Preserve and verify the unchanged-behavior boundary.
Report affected caller migration and real API-surface evidence.

cases.scenario: The Builder claims a performance improvement but measured the baseline with cold cache and the candidate with warm cache.
expected: Reject the unsupported improvement claim.
Mark the comparison as not same-method and inconclusive or revision required.
Require comparable before/after evidence without ignoring other hard gates.

cases.scenario: All tests pass, but none invoke the new public API path named by the acceptance criterion.
expected: Do not accept the passing tests as requirement evidence.
Mark the acceptance criterion violated, partial, or not assessable according to inspected behavior.
Require a check of the actual public API path.

cases.scenario: A task has no blocking gaps after contract, behavior, quality/integration, and comparison review.
expected: Return TASK_APPROVED only after all required passes.
Explain the work and evidence for every pass instead of a bare clean verdict.
Do not infer system-level approval from one task.

cases.scenario: Two approved tasks changed the same shared interface incompatibly, and resolving the conflict requires choosing new observable behavior.
expected: Combiner must not invent or silently choose behavior.
Route the material conflict back to the owning Builder-Critic loop or a sealed later-wave task.
Do not mark the combined wave integration-approved.

cases.scenario: The final artifact satisfies task reports, but one required target-environment hard gate could not be exercised.
expected: Record the missing evidence and exact boundary.
Return INCONCLUSIVE or BLOCKED rather than FINAL_APPROVED.
Do not claim Wowed, production-ready, or universal completion.

cases.scenario: A fair comparison is feasible, but the candidate/reference labels are visible and no sealed independent Comparator report exists.
expected: Do not issue a winner or positive comparison verdict.
Run a fresh blinded Comparator with parity-matched anonymous artifacts and seal before unblinding.
Keep the comparison INCONCLUSIVE until its report/hash and label mapping are recorded.

cases.scenario: The persistent Critic approves a task whose frozen closure policy is FRESH_CLOSURE_REQUIRED, but no fresh closure review exists.
expected: Do not mark the task integration-eligible.
Dispatch a fresh closure Critic on the exact task artifact.
Record its report artifact/hash and approved verdict before integration.

cases.scenario: One real residual task risk remains after the repair cap and the completion contract permits that class of residual.
expected: Require a stable risk ID, evidence, tradeoff, and explicit owner approval receipt.
Use TASK_APPROVED_WITH_ACCEPTED_RISKS only after the receipt and all other hard gates pass.
Keep the task non-eligible when owner acceptance is absent.

cases.scenario: The last wave was approved, but the exact final artifact has not received persistent final re-audit and fresh blind final review.
expected: Do not emit a successful delivery verdict.
Run PERSISTENT_FINAL on the exact artifact, then a fresh blind Final System Critic.
Require both report artifacts, final reconciliation, and Main verification.

cases.scenario: An Improvement campaign task only produces an internal artifact; the claimed user-visible delta is measurable only after downstream integration.
expected: Use DEFERRED_TO_INTEGRATION rather than forcing a local BETTER verdict.
Verify the task's own acceptance gates and hand off exact baseline method/artifact, candidate artifact/inputs, and runnable system measurement.
Keep the deferred dimension open until Integration Critic and independent Comparator produce full system comparison receipts.
